families.name: idle
families.reason: The raccoon stands in a neutral posture, sniffing the ground and shifting its weight slightly while looking around.

families.name: walk-right
families.reason: A standard walk cycle with the raccoon moving toward the right with its head lowered.

families.name: walk-left
families.reason: A separate left-facing walk cycle, frames 15-22 (owner confirmed 2026-11-08).

families.name: crouch-hop
families.reason: The raccoon lowers its body into a crouch, pauses to glance at the viewer (frames 24-25), and then crawls forward.

families.name: walk-right-alert
families.reason: An alternative walk cycle moving to the right, characterized by a more upright head position.

families.name: sit-groom
families.reason: The raccoon sits up on its hind legs and turns its head to look around.

notes: Frames 15-22 are explicit left-facing walks that perfectly mirror the right-facing walks in 7-14. Frames 32-39 represent a distinct walk cycle from 7-14 with different head and tail placement. Confirmed by the owner (Kirk, 2026-11-08) with walk-left as frames 15-22, not a mirror.
